candidate_reports.remark: Broadcast media reported street flooding in Palmetto Bay from persistent showers and thunderstorms. Nearby rainfall observations indicated a little over 4 inches of rain fell during the late morning and midday time frame.
West End Lake Okeechobee Mesonet measured 41 kts or 48 mph.
Picture received via social media of water at the doors of a home in the area of Military Trail and Shenandoah Drive in West Palm Beach.
Off-duty emergency manager reports water entering homes in the area of Northlake Blvd and the Florida Turnpike in Palm Beach Gardens.

Broadcast media reported submerged streets and floodwater entering homes in the Lone Pine Estates community of Riviera Beach_ Florida. Images show about half a foot to a foot of water in this area_ with some damage due to flooding along several properties and to vehicles.
Street flooding along Banyan Blvd and Australian Ave in downtown West Palm Beach. Several inches to half a foot of water accumulating along the roadways and over the curbs.
Social Media images show water entering homes in the area near Military Trail and Community Drive in West Palm Beach. Flooded roadways in the area as well.
Time estimated report based on radar of heaviest rain. Observer reported 1 to 2 feet of water inside a parking lot in Boca Raton.
Off duty NWS employee observed at least a dozen stalled out vehicles in high water due to flash flooding around the Sawgrass Mills Mall.

Multiple vehicles stalled in flood waters near the intersection of Powerline Road and Copans Road in Pompano Beach. At least 7 vehicles required towing_ and water reached at least a foot deep_ halfway up the tires of an SUV. Nearby rainfall observations indicated over 4 inches of rain in a 3-hour period.
Images from real time media depict an overflowing in-ground pool and flooding in grassy areas of backyards in the Stonebrook Estates community in Davie.
Broadcast media shares images of street flooding blending in with nearby canal.
